selected_report_core.local_static_boundary: The follow-up may build report structures, decoder constants, validators, and task docs for MII_CTRL1000/MII_STAT1000 only. It may not run hardware or add GPIO32, BMCR write, Broadcom shadow/MMD/aux, interrupt ISR, PHY configuration, MACB configuration, packet I/O, networking, SSH, Phase 12.2, or phase-transition behavior.

findings.finding: The preflight splits pure Clause 22 read candidates from selector-write, read-with-side-effect, and write-adjacent Broadcom surfaces.
MII_CTRL1000 and MII_STAT1000 are the only selected targets for the next local/static report-core follow-up.
BMCR, BMSR, ANAR/ANLPAR, and MACB_NSR repeats are same-shaped against the accepted phy-not-ready frontier and are not selected.
MII_BCM54XX_ISR is rejected for the report core because retained Linux source treats ISR reads as interrupt acknowledgement/clear-pending.
MII_BCM54XX_ECR and MII_BCM54XX_IMR reads are deferred as interrupt context only; their writes remain forbidden.
Broadcom AUX/shadow delay and Clause 45/MMD EEE reads are blocked from the read-only set because retained Linux source requires selector writes before reading.
The accepted physical Ethernet link precondition remains accepted and was not re-asked.
No source, helper, task, or evidence files were removed.
